newsitem.title: USA: Canmax says to merge with Auto-Gas Systems.
newsitem.headline: Canmax says to merge with Auto-Gas Systems.

text.p: Canmax Inc said Tuesday it has signed an agreement to merge with privately held Auto-Gas Systems Inc of Abilene, Texas through a stock deal.

Conmax said Auto-Gas' shareholders will receive about 5.2 million shares of its common stock. An additional 1.5 million shares will be reserved for issuance when options and warrants held by Auto-Gas shareholders are exercised.
Canmax will be the surviving entity in the merger.
The merger is scheduled to close by October 31, Canmax's fiscal year end.
